title: yaml.load() without SafeLoader on external bus message body in handle()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/telemetry_consumer.py:L17 calls yaml.load(message.body) without a Loader; message.body arrives from an external message bus and is attacker-controlled; PyYAML's default Loader allows arbitrary Python object construction, enabling remote code execution.
owaspCategory: A08 Software and Data Integrity Failures
